text: {"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["bakbakcixan (lust / fornication)", "û pectzil (the rumor / news of)", "ꝑel (only / sole in 'ù ꝑel mehen')"], "added": ["bad"], "mistranslated": ["bai tun Xithic û pectzil û lobil û beel (so the rumor of his evil conduct spread abroad) -> and so his evil ways grew worse", "maix tan û kantal û yatal tauol (it will not delay to grieve your heart) -> and you will find no time in your heart", "y ù noc kixob (garment of thorns) -> crowned with thorns", "y ù hach yatal tin Uol (and it grieves my heart deeply) -> and had great love in my heart"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["bakbakcixan (lust / fornication)"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["bul (gambling) -> revelry", "ma hakotzil ca chacanacentii (no wonder that I resemble him) -> Do not be afraid that I appear to you"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is substantially more accurate and preserves the source's difficult idioms and phrasing, whereas Translation A severely garbles several clauses, including turning the pain in Christ's heart into love and producing nonsense for the warning about future regret."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["and it stops moving as well"], "mistranslated": ["hebal c tucliceex â hanonexe (what we think while awake) -> that come when we sleep"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["he (here is)", "u pel (Person)"], "added": ["of a well"], "mistranslated": ["hach chacan tech (very clear to you) -> very like you", "Chen y à pacticabae ca yuchul hahibe (it happens truly only when you look at yourselves) -> although you see yourself in it, it does not truly come into being", "paibe t yinhi (existed before) -> was born before", "tan â culpachticeex hahal Dioz (turn your backs on the true God) -> that you take for the true God", "hebal c tucliceex â hanonexe (what we think while awake) -> what we were thinking while eating", "topzazil utial tulacal baal (supremely clear to all things) -> for it is the beginning of all things", "û chichnile (the younger one) -> One of them was very diligent"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is a remarkably faithful and accurate rendering of the colonial Maya text with only minor slips, whereas Translation B suffers from numerous severe mistranslations and an added phrase."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["xma â nahalticoob (without earning them)", "kahez (remember)", "ú tħibete (to visit him)"], "added": ["sinners (inserted in place of u chucanob 'the rest/others')"], "mistranslated": ["h ma cux olé (foolish/senseless one) -> hard-hearted one", "chok cħintah (dashed/hurled) -> sprinkled", "pahzubtal (shame/disgrace) -> condemnation", "u chucanob (the rest/others) -> sinners", "max ù hoch bilan (pale as a shadow) -> no longer himself", "lay à lob lakilob (those evil companions of yours) -> those flowers and pleasures", "kahez ɔocan à manzic u yanalob àzab nohob (remember that after you endure this, other far greater things will come) -> you have had enough of other things already", "à culpachticoob (to renounce them) -> as you confess them", "ùyabal alabolal (great faith/trust) -> great joy", "caxi (although/even if) -> Perhaps", "caxi hach pachalace (even if it is very late) -> Quickly", "ú tħibete hach chacan tiob layob catulob t maniebe (to visit him, appearing clearly to both of them who were passing the night there) -> whose appearance was very like the two who had come before"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["in Uutzcinticob (to benefit/restore them) -> to redeem them", "ti alakoob (by [your] dependents/household) -> by the women"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is remarkably accurate and captures complex colonial Maya idioms and grammar, whereas Translation A suffers from numerous severe mistranslations including rendering 'evil companions' as 'flowers and pleasures' and 'even if it is very late' as 'quickly'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["heaniix (and open)", "ú Kabilob (its hands)"], "added": ["the medicine of"], "mistranslated": ["yokol ú noh celembal (above his magnificent youthful form) -> on his great shoulder", "y ú yabal Zahcil (and such great fear/dread) -> with such brightness", "ú alabolal (hope/trust) -> glory", "tan à chaibenzic ú yabal tibil beob (performing many good deeds) -> and ask pardon of the many good people", "cu ɔanuc tabaal toneex y lay Cilich can (is made known to us through this holy teaching) -> whatever is given to us, and this holy story"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["tu pazel (to the hut/dwelling of) -> to visit", "y ú yabal Zahcil (and such great fear/dread) -> and one full of misery"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B is significantly more accurate and faithful to the colonial Yucatec Maya theological text, whereas A introduces several notable mistranslations such as rendering 'celembal' as shoulder and 'tibil beob' as good people."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["cainac (enter, in 'cainac cilich Zazil tu natoob')", "uꝑel (one / only, in 'caat emi uꝑel mehen Dioz')"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ú cha campahal ta Uuyahexloe (the receiving of instruction that you have heard) -> these appearances you have heard about took place", "bai bic tun (just as / how) -> Because"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["<note>A small decorative initial letter B opens the section.</note>"], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B accurately renders the Yucatec Maya grammar and vocabulary throughout, whereas Translation A mistranslates the reception of doctrine as appearances and contains multiple omissions, although Translation B includes an erroneous note describing the large initial B as small."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["le kabóob (the hands / hands dropping down)", "cú omancilóob le xnokolilóob (the worms teem / swarm)"], "added": ["and of envy", "The world, vanity, and everything that changes with them"], "mistranslated": ["le kabóob cú lubulóob ti (the hands drop down) -> Because of the sins into which it falls", "le pacatóob cú kalicubaóob (the eyes close) -> the glances it allows itself", "ù káatóob ú ɔálpach (they turn their backs on) -> it still keeps up", "tu tiblilóob (in their goodness / virtues) -> of its forebears", "tuil cuxtal (fetid / corrupt life) -> the delights of this passing life", "cheh ƀacilil ti cristiano (a mockery of a Christian) -> a complete coldness as a Christian", "iix má tu yiláal ù yanal ƀáal cá ú yetez chiculilóob ti le uchƀen cichcelmil (nothing else is seen displaying signs of the ancient beauty) -> Nothing else is seen in it but the marks of the soul's former beauty", "olmail ... ú zutticuƀá ... ti ú yuchƀenil yantalé (difficult ... to return to its former state) -> what a misfortune it is that the soul is turned away from what it once was", "le tohuolal (health) -> the remedy", "yaƀalóob yailóob (many pains) -> a few pains"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ua leyli náapzahàanil má tu heɔcuntic (whether experience itself does not confirm this) -> whether, if it is constantly delayed, it does not settle", "tioklal le napzah (out of habit / custom) -> because of neglect"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is vastly superior and remarkably faithful, accurately translating anatomical terms, vivid metaphors, and syntactic structures that Translation A repeatedly omitted, fabricated, or reversed in meaning."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ti leyli tèex (to your very selves)", "ticħóob (outstretched hands)"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["what it causes to the sinner ... to the Giver of our forgiveness -> what the sinner owes ... what is owed to the Giver of pardon", "out of mere weakness, rather than stubborn obstinacy -> to be a very good and loving thing, without great difficulty", "the severe violence of temptation, rather than deliberate contempt -> a firm trial, without thought of resisting", "great subjection under another, rather than freedom in the very same will -> great strength, without opposition of the will", "wallowing in that mud -> turned aside and ready to depart", "as many days as we separate ourselves from God's presence ... so much the more unworthy do we make ourselves -> How often have you rejected the grace of God ... Great is the ingratitude you show him", "we urge you to call -> let us hasten to call"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is an exceptionally accurate and nuanced rendering of the colonial Yucatec Maya text, whereas Translation B suffers from numerous severe mistranslations that distort the author's theological arguments."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["yayatulul (grievous)"], "added": ["vanity", "in parables"], "mistranslated": ["fulfillment of your will -> the honor of your will", "to rest -> turn away", "Pardoner of our sins -> our offended Savior", "with urgency -> in parables", "as if spoken to the wind -> just as they sound", "deserve the most earnest attention -> signify something very grave", "swiftly awakens -> foretelling"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is complete and highly accurate throughout, while Translation B severely mistranslates multiple key theological terms and clauses in the sermon passage."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["mix huntul á uohelmá (as no one knows as you know) -> not one of us knows", "cá má c paymaéex kaholticéex (that we do not first recognize [it]) -> whom we do not first recognize"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["cú cilba, iix cú xibil ú kikel (trembles, and one's blood curdles)", "ti á ual (from your child)", "hele ú nuculintic (today he intends)"], "added": ["being spoken of here", "vanity", "now weighing upon us"], "mistranslated": ["cá leti uol hach heɔáan cú cilba, iix cú xibil ú kikel (so that the soul, thoroughly terrified, trembles, and one's blood curdles) -> hold that the very firm thought being spoken of here", "ti zebchilah (in haste) -> in parable", "ú pocħol Dios (the profaning/reviling of God) -> which kindles God's wrath", "cá má c paymaéex kaholticéex (that we do not first recognize) -> Let us not be slow to recognize", "hebic yumtzil iix ah yacunah (like a loving lord and father) -> as you see, fathers and loved ones", "táan á káatic ti á ual (asking from your child) -> as I ask you", "cà û núuctenóob (that they may answer me) -> to understand it", "Ahzáat-zah zipiléex (our Forgiver of sins) -> our offended Savior", "ti tulacal ù nummia (in all their afflictions) -> in all his very great tribulations", "tibilbeilóob, iix nuculilóob hakobilóob (good virtues and wondrous instructions) -> affronts and great sorrows", "xmá ú capelcuntáal (beyond doubt / indubitable) -> and cannot be counted", "ti ú ɔiliƀ (in his writing) -> in his example"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is complete and highly faithful with only minor slips in pronominal reference, whereas Translation B leaves out key phrases and contains numerous severe mistranslations and inversions of meaning throughout."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["zeƀlacil (quickly)"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["In heláancuntah bahun leytiá Ahzáat-zahuléex (how our Savior changed this) -> Our offended Savior was greatly angered at this", "Ahzáat-zah zipil (forgiver of sins) -> offended Savior", "uaiix tá kaholticéex (or what you recognize/know) -> or through ignorance", "ti hach nohochil hatzul ti le kulnaéex (in the greater part of your churches) -> as very great offenses in the temple", "tulacal xakáan (everything mixed up / in confusion) -> all spilled out"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is complete and accurately renders the Yucatec Maya grammar and religious terminology, whereas Translation A suffers from several severe mistranslations, including rendering the forgiver of sins as an offended Savior and translating a verb of knowing as ignorance."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ti leitió (besides these)"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Hebic y le ú mehentzilóob Diosé ('as with the children of God' -> 'Just as God acts toward His children')"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["chucanil ('completely' / 'fully')"], "added": ["loves"], "mistranslated": ["hebic le iglesia y Cristo ('just as the Church and Christ' -> 'as Christ loves the Church')"]}, "better": "tie", "comment": "Both translations are closely matched in quality, each having one omitted phrase and one mistranslated passage, with A being more faithful in the fifth commandment question and the comparison of spouses to Christ and the Church, while B better captures the relations of masters and servants and includes 'besides these' in the sixth question."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ti ú yalahul (with deliberation / consent)"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Mayli cú nahaltic (rather he gains merit) -> No, as long as they do not consent", "le nuculóob kebané (the occasions of sin) -> those sinful things"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B accurately translates the theological phrases throughout, while Translation A completely alters the response regarding gaining merit from resisting bad thoughts and omits the condition of consent."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["will it suffice / be enough to confess sin -> will they be forgiven by confessing their sin", "endless things / matters without end -> falsehoods"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["worldly", "vain words"], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "B accurately translates the grammatical and doctrinal sense of the source text, correctly rendering the question of sufficiency and the reference to endless matters where A mistranslates both."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["y ꝑelelil almahtħan (by a separate/particular commandment) -> by these commandments"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["tiꝑáan éma ú yanal tioklal tu beil tibilil (other than or beyond for a good purpose) -> for good purposes, in a right way", "cú laytal (arise from them) -> behind them are themselves evil", "zazilcuntic (to make clear / illuminate) -> fulfill"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is accurate with only a minor slip regarding the separate commandment, whereas Translation B inverts the sense of the opening question and mistranslates 'zazilcuntic' (to make clear) as 'fulfill'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ú yabal misa (Mass is said / spoken of) -> you hear Mass often", "h maxulunté Yum (Infinite Lord) -> Most High Lord", "zut-zah yacunahóob (return of love) -> for his benefits", "cú nahinticóob (benefit) -> are offered"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is faithful and precise throughout, whereas Translation A substitutes standard Spanish catechism phrasing that mistranslates several Maya terms, notably rendering 'yabal' (said) as hearing and 'nahintic' (benefit) as offered."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["use of", "or"], "mistranslated": ["vi pe (derives from / comes from) -> use of", "ru ꜯiriçaxic (its absolution) -> its being applied", "pa ꜭhavomariçabal hay (in the house of purification) -> or in the hospital"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["vi pe (comes from / derives from)", "rahilaxic (its reading)"], "added": ["of a person's death"], "mistranslated": ["ra hilaxic paru vi (its reading over him) -> receives absolution upon oneself", "tu nimacochih (receives as a grant/grace) -> will truly <unclear>be cleansed</unclear>", "ruꜫitahic (visitation) -> in the peril [of a person's death]", "tahilax paru vi (it is read over him) -> One is absolved upon oneself"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is better because it correctly identifies the reading of the Bull (ahilaj) over the penitent in both instances where B mistakenly translates it as absolution, despite A mistranslating the house of purification as a hospital."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["great mercy shown to him (ru nima hoyeuaxic, ru vaꜭh) -> it is greatly to be honored, its presence", "fervent / ardent (ah ghumum) -> proud", "burning of heart / contrite (ah ꜫatat gux) -> hard-hearted", "sorrowful / contrite people (ah biꜯ) -> songsters", "weepers (ah oꜫel) -> merrymakers", "with sorrow (ꜭhibiꜯ) -> and with hymns"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["while [the priest] gives absolution (tan ti giꜯ ruça ꜭh)", "it is necessary / fitting (ha ahoxel)"], "added": ["before"], "mistranslated": ["he shall bear / endure patiently (tu coꜭhih) -> it will truly be completed for one", "face / mercy (ru vaꜭh in hoyeuaxic ruvach) -> its fruit", "you hear / listen (ti vagaxah) -> we must know", "concerning its proper benefit / nature (ꜭhipe ru ꜭhohmil vae) -> how this is to be used"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B is better because it correctly identifies the devotional vocabulary of contrition and sorrow required for confession, whereas Translation A confuses bis ('sorrow') with bix ('song') and absurdly turns contrite penitents into proud, hard-hearted merrymakers."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["torment (the noun rayil, completed by the catchword yi)"], "added": ["taken away"], "mistranslated": ["ruꜫatatibal (contrition/breaking of heart) -> warming of our hearts", "tikatohbeh (so that we may make satisfaction for it) -> so that we may be helped", "ti ka gexertacibeh (we commute) -> so that we may receive forgiveness", "paru ꜭhij (from the burning heat) -> from the point", "pa nim rayil, pokonal (into the great torment [and] suffering) -> into that great and painful", "ru camah (its work/effect) -> power"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A expertly renders the colonial Kaqchikel doctrinal vocabulary and uses the catchword correctly, whereas Translation B commits numerous major lexical and theological mistranslations."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["the punishment for"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhavomariçabal hay (house of cleansing/purification) -> house of torment", "1st-person plural markers in kumal, xkilih, xka guxlaah (we/our) -> 3rd-person (someone/they/their)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["tan ti gamon vi lo (is now received from this)"], "added": ["our fasting", "the mortification of our bodies"], "mistranslated": ["rubanic kuꜯilah banoh (the doing of good works) -> the doing of our penance", "ka ꜯol ꜫomibal kij (our wasting of days) -> our fasting, the mortification of our bodies", "ruꜫat bal (means of cutting off / putting an end to) -> brings about", "ri ru tohel rumac (the debt of their sin) -> the one who pays for their sins", "ti be ta ru toho (which they would have gone to pay) -> shall not go to pay for them"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A captures the syntax, idioms, and counterfactual grammar of the passage with high fidelity despite mistranslating the epithet for purgatory, whereas Translation B hallucinates penitential practices, reverses the meaning of the Bull's function, and truncates the final clause."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ꜭhikih ('for them', lines 13-14)"], "added": ["find", "Also cancelled is", "it is as if"], "mistranslated": ["rupenayl (penalty/punishment) -> pain", "ꜭhiki ꜭhin / ꜭhikih (to them / for them) -> to you", "ylah (divine/holy) -> ylah ('perhaps grant or decree')", "tan tihath (is offered/distributed) -> is now received", "ca ca huna (every two years) -> for a span of two years"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B captures the Kaqchikel syntax, theological vocabulary, and grammatical person with exceptional fidelity, whereas Translation A misrenders several key terms, confuses third-person pronouns for second-person, and adds fabricated clauses."}
